Preserve identity, face, skin tone, hair, eyes, costume, accessories, colors and rendering. Preserve her Tall Female proportions, long braid and outfit. Show distinct expressive acting with a genuinely varied pose: puzzled brows and a head tilt, one hand turned gently upward near the waist. Keep normal pupils. Simple, readable hands near the torso; each visible hand has one anatomically correct thumb and four fingers connected to one palm and wrist. Do not force hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and feet with an uncomplicated stance. Keep the entire silhouette including hair, headwear, accessories, hands and shoes visible, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding, without lengthening the body. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
